Overview
A fully integrated Microsoft security solution that works out of the box.
24×7 event threat monitoring & threat detection filters, normalizes, correlates, and analyzes data to find threats across endpoints.
Data Privacy: protect your data from unauthorized disclosure
Overview of your risk exposure along with actionable automated insights.
Deployment, configuration and management of Microsoft product.
Maximize your investment in Microsoft licenses.

Platform Management
